description: This file defines structures and functions for discovering wide area gateways over a network using DNS-SD and Tailscale status. It includes mechanisms for querying DNS records, parsing TXT records, and running system commands to gather network information.

classes.name: TailscaleStatus
classes.description: Decodable structure representing the Tailscale status JSON, including self node and peer nodes.

methods.name: discover
methods.description: Main method to discover wide area gateways within a specified timeout, returning a list of beacon structures.

methods.name: collectTailnetIPv4s
methods.description: Extracts IPv4 addresses associated with the current tailnet from the Tailscale status JSON.

methods.name: readTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Attempts to read the Tailscale status by executing the tailscale binary, checking multiple possible locations.

methods.name: loadWideAreaPtrRecords
methods.description: Performs DNS queries to load PTR records for the wide area gateway domain, returns domain info and PTR lines.

methods.name: runDig
methods.description: Helper method to execute the 'dig' command with specified arguments and timeout.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a given process with arguments and returns the trimmed output.

methods.name: parseSrv
methods.description: Parses the SRV DNS record output to extract host and port information.

methods.name: parseTxtTokens
methods.description: Parses TXT DNS records into tokens, unescaping as needed.

methods.name: unescapeTxt
methods.description: Unescapes DNS TXT record escape sequences.

methods.name: mapTxt
methods.description: Maps TXT token array into a dictionary of key-value pairs.

methods.name: parseInt
methods.description: Converts a string to an integer if possible.

methods.name: isTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Checks if a given IP string is a valid tailnet IPv4 address based on specific octet ranges.

methods.name: decodeDnsSdEscapes
methods.description: Decodes escape sequences in DNS Service Discovery labels.
